subject: Applied Therapeutic Drug Dosing and Regimen Calculation
topic: Worked Clinical Dosing: Conversational Walkthrough vs. Explicit State Execution Trace
syllabus_context: Clinical Pharmacokinetics Unit 4: Aminoglycoside and Glycopeptide Dosing. Creatinine clearance estimation, Cockcroft-Gault equation, loading dose calculation, maintenance dose determination, and dosing interval adjustment.
declared_learning_objective: Calculate individual creatinine clearance using the Cockcroft-Gault equation, determine loading and maintenance doses for narrow therapeutic index antibiotics, evaluate conversational clinical approximations versus rigorous multi-step calculation traces, and adjust dosing regimens for renal impairment.

recording_quality.known_observability_limitations: Verbal dialogue combined with blackboard calculation steps and unit conversions.
